description:
Cross-platform encrypted email client Aster Mail is a cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted email client built for Aster Privacy. Features quantum-safe encryption and zero-knowledge architecture.

> [!NOTE] > These files are for new installations. If Aster Mail is already installed, it updates automatically. ## What's new • On Windows, this update brings everything from Aster Mail 1.4.67, including folder sorting, rules from search filters, recovery codes, relative dates, and Brazilian Portuguese. ## Fixed • The Windows installer installs the current version of Aster Mail, and Windows installs update automatically again. • The unread count appears on the Aster Mail icon in the Windows taskbar.
